history.name: The record is found from wherever you are
history.description: Commands work from anywhere inside a project: the record is located by looking upward from the current directory, so nobody has to be at the top of the repository to use it. It can also be pointed at explicitly, which is what lets one checkout work on another project's record, and a missing one is reported with the command that would create it.
history.dev_notes: findLedgerDir() walks up looking for .ledger/config.json; --dir and $LEDGER_DIR override, honoured by every command.
